preconditions.description: The number of files to delete m is between 1 and n, and n is at most 100.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(f, str) and len(f) > 0 and all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() or c == '.' for c in f) for f in filenames)
preconditions.description: All filenames are non-empty strings containing only lowercase letters, digits, and dots.
There are exactly n distinct filenames.

preconditions.expression: len(indices) == m and all(1 <= i <= n for i in indices) and indices == sorted(indices)
preconditions.description: The indices list has m distinct integers in ascending order, each between 1 and n.
Each filename length does not exceed 100.

postconditions.description: The first line of output is either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'No' or (len(output_lines) == 2 and output_lines[0] == 'Yes' and pattern == output_lines[1])
postconditions.description: If the first line is 'Yes', the second line contains the pattern; otherwise, there is only one line.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'No' or (all(match_pattern(pattern, f) for f in to_delete) and all(not match_pattern(pattern, f) for f in to_keep))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, the pattern matches all files to be deleted and matches none of the files to keep.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'No' or (all(len(f) == len(pattern) for f in to_delete) and all(len(f) != len(pattern) or any(c != '?' and c != f[i] for i, c in enumerate(pattern)) for f in to_keep))
postconditions.description: The pattern length equals the length of all files to delete, and for every file to keep, either lengths differ or there is a position where the pattern character is not '?' and differs from the filename character.
